name: Falerno del Massico

known.via: English Wikipedia "Falerno del Massico" (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A DOC in Caserta province, in Campania, from five communes including Carinola and Sessa Aurunca. It makes a white from Falanghina, a red led by Aglianico with Piedirosso, and a Primitivo.
